verdict.rationale: Disclosing operating hours, daily limits or session timeouts before starting is a fair question for an online government filing portal like ANEF, so the axis applies. The pack contains only probes of the front door: the ANEF host serves a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with almost no readable text, and the ministry site returns a Cloudflare challenge. Neither shows any published hours, per-day limits or session-timeout notice.
